repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the candidate checks if volume rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the candidate incorrectly triggered an action when the volume was high (20 vs 0), whereas the IR would not have triggered because v1 (0) - v2 (20) = -20, which is not >= 20.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic for detecting a drop.
